testimonials.heading: What our clients say.
testimonials.subtitle: Real numbers. Real businesses. Valencia and surroundings.

items.quote: I had a PDF menu nobody understood. Now German and French guests order without any problem. It was installed in 4 days and I didn't have to do a thing.
items.author: Carlos M.

items.quote: My personal WhatsApp no longer rings at 11pm. The 5-language guest guide resolves everything before they even ask. Reviews went from 7.8 to 9.1.
items.author: Ana R.

items.stat_label: recovered per month in lost appointments
items.quote: No-shows dropped 70% in the first month. My receptionist now has real time to look after patients instead of spending hours on confirmation calls.
items.author: Dr. Salvador P.

items.a: It depends on the product: digital menu in 3–5 days, smart reception in 5–7 days, smart scheduler in 7–10 days. From first payment to working system in your business.

items.q: Do I need technical knowledge to use the system?
items.a: No. We configure everything. You receive the system ready to use and we show you how in 30 minutes. If you have questions afterwards, direct WhatsApp support.

items.q: Can I cancel at any time?
items.a: Yes. No lock-in. We only need 30 days notice for monthly subscription services. Setup payments are one-off — no mandatory recurring charges.

items.q: Are my data and my clients' data safe?
items.a: Yes. Full GDPR compliance. For clinics: clinical data is never touched. The reminder system only uses name, phone number and appointment time — nothing more.

items.q: How is Seny different from a marketing agency?
items.a: Agencies recommend. We install. We don't leave a report on the table — we stay until the system works in your business. And we come from hospitality: we know how your business works from the inside.

items.q: What happens if something breaks after installation?
items.a: Direct WhatsApp support. We respond within 4 hours during business hours. If the issue is on our side, we fix it at no extra cost.
